application.scope: Full application suite with native audio core parity. Engine-dependent cases requiring explicit tool configuration may skip; real Godot tests are run separately.

overlap: Focused JavaScript tests are included in or overlap the application suite; totals are not added. Rust, browser, actual engine and prepared copies are distinct evidence levels.
boundaries: Independent non-spatial music/effect tracks with volume, looping and timed play/stop cues; role is a label, not a mixer bus.
Runtime resources are bounded standard PCM16 WAV; media-library support remains separate.
Existing audio-document scalar editing only; no first-creation wizard or track/cue structural UI.
Godot PCM was captured through its native mixer using an isolated muted bus and Dummy driver; physical speakers were not verified.
Bevy audio, behavior-event-triggered sounds, spatial audio, control-replay composition and Android audio runtime are not implemented.
Browser and prepared-module checks do not claim a new installed Tauri build, Android device or standalone game binary.
